- Tue 6/6 10:00–11:00

Hi Sophie — thanks for the options and for outlining attendees.

We can consolidate and run a single 60-minute session that covers:
- Quick product recap (10 min)
- Walkthrough of your redline comments (35 min)
- Open items & next steps (15 min)

From Redwood, Karthik (legal ops) and Ben (solutions lead) will join — I will own the coordination.

Prefer Wed 6/7 16:00–17:00 PDT to give our team time to incorporate any pre-call notes. If that works for you, I will:
- Send a calendar invite to all attendees
- Attach our MSA counter (Octave_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) and insurance summary
- Flag the specific clauses we want to table (liability, data handling, termination)

If you need an earlier slot, we can try Tue 6/6 10:00 but Ben is limited that morning.

Thanks,

Looping in to confirm Redwood's agenda and owners. Laura — happy to lead the clause review. Ben can cover deployment/hosting and technical expectations.

A couple of asks before we lock the calendar: 
1) Please share the consolidated redline document (PDF preferred) so we can pre-annotate replies.
2) Let us know if your GC will attend or if we should plan to take legal-only follow-ups afterward.
3) Confirm Jordan's email for calendar invite (Icc'd Procurement alias but Jordan isn't listed).

If Wed 6/7 16:00–17:00 PDT is confirmed, I'll book a Zoom and include a read-ahead.

Thanks — Karthik

Thanks Karthik — Jordan (cc) is our procurement lead and will join. Our GC is tentatively available on the Wed afternoon slot but may ask to join only for the redline portion.

I've attached a consolidated PDF of our comments and a short procurement checklist — please review the following items pre-call:
- Section 5: Data retention (we ask for a 7-year retention right for audit)
- Section 9: Liability cap language (requesting $10M cap)
- Appendix B: Subprocessors list

We also need proof of SOC 2 or an attestation during the call. Can Redwood confirm SOC 2 scope and whether you can share the report or an overview?

If Wed 6/7 16:00 works, Jordan can send a calendar acceptance once you send the invite.

Sophie
